Use this template to propose a short explainer for the **Modelling Assumptions and Decisions** discussion category. Once submitted, an admin will review and publish it as a discussion post, with an entry added to the assumptions index in the repo.

Preliminary discussion of an assumption, before it's ready for a formal write-up, is welcome in the **General** or **Help desk and Q&A** categories.
